title: Klasikoen Gordailua (Euskal Klasikoen Corpusa, UPV/EHU)
notes: Klasikoen Gordailua (Repository of Classics), run by armiarma.eus since 2005, which aims to gather nearly all classic Basque texts up to the twentieth century; its search tool, the Corpus Arakatzailea, dates from 2007. The Basque Classics Corpus (Euskal Klasikoen Corpusa) of the UPV/EHU Institute of the Basque Language republishes this material (published there on 2013-12-05; author Joseba Ezeiza): 496 books from the 16th century to 1975, searchable by author, period, dialect and genre. The whole corpus can be downloaded as a single file in TEI or RTF. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
